adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, usernames are processed with `if user = User.find_by_username(username)` and non-existent usernames are silently skipped; the action still returns success if `group.save` succeeds. In the updated specs, there are tests for adding several members and for automatic groups, but no test asserting behavior for unknown usernames. The previously existing incremental test `"succeeds silently when adding non-existent users"` was removed with the PATCH-based flow and not replaced for the new `add_members` endpoint, leaving this behavior undocumented/unguarded by tests.
